text: In Lab 15, at what feedback gain η is NARMA-10 NMSE minimized, and what happens beyond η ≈ 1.0?
choices: Minimized near η ≈ 0.1; beyond 1.0 it keeps improving
Minimized near η ≈ 1.5; below 1.0 the system is unusable
Minimized at η = 0; any feedback hurts performance
Minimized near η ≈ 0.8–0.9; beyond η ≈ 1.0 the system saturates and performance degrades
explanation: The lab reports best NMSE near η ≈ 0.8–0.9 — the 'edge of stability', where the loop has long fading memory yet still separates inputs. Past η ≈ 1.0 the sin² node saturates and accuracy falls off. With η = 0 (option 2) there is no memory at all, so performance is poor, contradicting the other options.
